name: PinPinMe Content Connector for Pinterest
author: PinPinMe

sections.description:
Turn your WordPress content into Pinterest-ready drafts

PinPinMe connects your WordPress site and WooCommerce store to one searchable content catalog.

After an administrator explicitly connects a PinPinMe account, the plugin keeps the enabled public content in sync. In PinPinMe you can choose a post, page, or product, create Pinterest-ready copy and visuals, schedule it, and track the result without copying content between tools.

The connector uses a small native WordPress settings page and does not embed an iframe or add anything to your public storefront.

Explore PinPinMe features | View pricing | Get support

See PinPinMe in action

Connector features

  • WordPress posts and pages: Synchronize enabled, published, non-password-protected content with titles, cleaned descriptions, permalinks, featured images, categories, tags, and publication dates.
  • WooCommerce products: Synchronize published parent products with names, descriptions, product URLs, prices, currency, SKU, stock state, categories, featured images, and gallery images.
  • Automatic background sync: New and updated content is queued and delivered in the background. A daily reconciliation helps keep the remote catalog aligned with the site.
  • One searchable catalog: Browse source cards in PinPinMe, search and filter them, and use Ignore/Restore to control the working set.
  • Reliable delivery: A durable local outbox retries temporary failures without making network requests inside WordPress save hooks.
  • Native WordPress controls: Choose whether to synchronize posts, pages, and products, start a manual refresh, review connection status, or disconnect.
  • WooCommerce-safe integration: The connector does not read or write orders, customers, carts, checkout data, coupons, or customer records. It declares HPOS compatibility.
  • Clean removal: Disconnecting requests connector revocation and imported catalog cleanup. Uninstalling also removes local PinPinMe plugin data.

Create, schedule, and learn in PinPinMe

Once content reaches PinPinMe, the external service provides the creative and publishing workflow:

  • AI pin copy: Generate titles, descriptions, alt text, and relevant terms from the selected source item.
  • Pinterest-ready publishing: Review the draft, choose media and a destination board, then publish when you are ready.
  • Smart scheduling: Place approved drafts into a visual content calendar.
  • Bulk scheduling: Prepare and schedule more than one item from your catalog.
  • Pinterest analytics: Bring publishing and performance context into the same workspace.

Connection, automatic synchronization, catalog browsing, search, filters, and Ignore/Restore are free. Creating a new AI-assisted draft uses the credits included with the selected PinPinMe plan. Synchronization by itself never creates a Pinterest draft, publishes a Pin, or spends AI credits.

How it works

  1. Install and activate PinPinMe. Activation makes no external request.
  2. Open PinPinMe in WordPress Admin and choose which public content types to enable.
  3. Click Connect PinPinMe, sign in on pinpinme.com, and explicitly approve the site.
  4. Let the initial catalog sync finish, then browse the imported source cards in PinPinMe.
  5. Select content, create a draft, review it, and schedule or publish it from the PinPinMe service.

WordPress and WooCommerce coverage

One plugin supports both:

  • Published WordPress posts and pages.
  • Published parent WooCommerce products.
  • Simple and variable parent product records as returned by WooCommerce.
  • Up to ten public product images per product.
  • Product type, current price, regular price, sale price, store currency, SKU, stock status, managed stock quantity, and product categories.

WooCommerce variations are not imported as separate cards. For variable products, the connector synchronizes the public parent product values returned by WooCommerce.

External service

This plugin connects to the PinPinMe software-as-a-service platform. The service is required for account connection, catalog storage, Pinterest-ready draft creation, scheduling, publishing, and other PinPinMe functionality.

When an administrator explicitly connects the plugin, it sends:

  • The public site URL and site name, an installation UUID, WordPress/plugin versions, and whether WooCommerce is active.
  • Enabled published, non-password-protected post/page titles, excerpts or cleaned text, public URLs, featured images, categories, tags, and publication dates.
  • Enabled published parent WooCommerce product names, descriptions, public URLs, prices, currency, SKU, stock state, categories, and public images.

It does not synchronize drafts, private/password-protected content, orders, customers, coupons, customer or WordPress-user email fields, WordPress user records, passwords, or WooCommerce product variations as separate items.

Data is sent only after an administrator approves the connection. Disconnecting requests connector revocation and removal of imported catalog data from PinPinMe while preserving Pinterest drafts already created there. Uninstalling makes the same best-effort request and always removes all local PinPinMe plugin data from WordPress.

  • PinPinMe Terms of Service
  • PinPinMe Privacy Policy
  • PinPinMe Support

Privacy

The plugin stores a random installation UUID, encrypted connection secret, synchronization preferences, status metadata, and a temporary local outbox in the WordPress database. Temporary authorization codes expire after ten minutes. Signed control requests expire after five minutes and are replay-protected.

See the detailed external-service disclosure above and the PinPinMe Privacy Policy.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the pinpinme folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install it from the WordPress plugin directory.
  2. Activate PinPinMe. Activation performs no external request.
  3. Open PinPinMe in WordPress Admin.
  4. Choose the public content types to synchronize and click Connect PinPinMe.
  5. Sign in or create an account on pinpinme.com, approve the site, and return to WordPress.
sections.faq:
Does the plugin embed PinPinMe in WordPress?

No. The settings page is native WordPress UI. Open PinPinMe opens the service in a separate browser tab.

Does connecting cost anything?

Connection, automatic synchronization, catalog cards, search, filters, and Ignore/Restore are free. Creating a new draft uses one AI credit under the limits of your PinPinMe plan.

Does synchronization publish to Pinterest automatically?

No. Synchronization only keeps the enabled public source catalog up to date in PinPinMe. It never creates a draft, publishes a Pin, or spends AI credits by itself. Publishing happens only after you use the creative and publishing workflow in the PinPinMe service.

What happens if WooCommerce is not installed?

WordPress post and page synchronization continues normally. The PinPinMe WooCommerce view reports that WooCommerce is not detected.

Which WooCommerce features are supported?

The connector reads published parent products through WooCommerce public APIs. It synchronizes public product content, prices, currency, SKU, stock state, categories, and up to ten product images. It is compatible with High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS) and does not alter the cart or checkout flow.

Are product variations imported separately?

No. A variable product is synchronized as one parent product card using the public parent values returned by WooCommerce. Individual variations are not imported as separate cards.

How quickly do content changes synchronize?

When automatic sync is enabled, supported publish, product, image, price, and stock changes are added to the background outbox. Delivery timing depends on WordPress Cron and server traffic. A daily reconciliation also checks the enabled catalog.

Are orders or customer records sent?

No. Orders, customers, coupons, their email fields, private content, credentials, and WordPress user records are excluded. As with any content connector, text intentionally published inside an enabled post, page, or product is part of that public content.

What happens when I deactivate the plugin?

Background jobs stop, but connection details are preserved so activation can resume syncing. Use Disconnect or uninstall the plugin to revoke the connection.
